audit.scope: Cash App trading analytics backend reconciliation

notes: FIFO is the authoritative lot-matching method.
Corporate actions include NVDA and AVGO 10:1 splits.
Gross profit and gross loss are calculated from individual FIFO fragments, not daily net P&L.
Current open exposure is measured by FIFO cost basis because reliable historical/current marks are not part of V1.
Capital velocity is a capital-recycling measure relative to gross external contributions, not standard portfolio turnover.
No standard Sharpe ratio or true annualized portfolio return is inferred from the available data.
